_comment: Copy this file to 'config.json' next to the Server and Indexer executables, then edit. config.json is gitignored because it can hold a SQL connection string and tokens. All values are strings (the loader parses numbers/bools).
_comment_huggingface: Optional: embed + rank via Hugging Face Inference Endpoints instead of local ONNX. Set the two URLs below and store the token with 'Server --set-secret HF_TOKEN hf_xxx' (or the HF_TOKEN env var). Leave the URLs blank to use the local ONNX models above.
